subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

Is the new policy expected to be implemented immediately across all departments?

options.text: Are they expecting to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?
Is the new policy implementing immediately across all departments?
Do they expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?
They expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Do they expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. To change it to the **active voice**, we need to identify the implied subject, which in this case is “they.”
 
• The sentence structure in active voice should follow the pattern: **Subject + Verb + Object**.
 
• The correct option, Option 3, rephrases the sentence in the active form as: **Do they expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?**
 
• The other options are incorrect because:
 
 
• **Option 1: Are they expecting to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?** - Incorrect because it uses the present continuous, which is not needed here.
 
• **Option 2: Is the new policy implementing immediately across all departments?** - Incorrect because it remains in the passive form and is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: They expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?** - Incorrect because it is not in the interrogative form as required by the original question.
 
 

Correct sentence: *Do they expect to implement the new policy immediately across all departments?*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active vs Passive Voice:**
 
 
• **Active voice:** The subject performs the action (e.g., “They expect to implement the policy.”).
 
• **Passive voice:** The subject receives the action (e.g., “The policy is expected to be implemented.”).
 
 
 
• While changing from passive to active voice, always identify the doer of the action and restructure the sentence accordingly.
